expression: :>> kappa = 1.0 {     // elongation. QI stellarator ~ circular average.
:>> n_e = 3.17e20 {   // vol-avg electron density [m^-3], point A (WI-022 corrected).
:>> p_pump = 195.0 {  // primary coolant pumping power [MW] -- helium-primary circulator basis (WI-033).
:>> p_tf = 0.0 {      // coil electrical drive power [MW] -- modeled zero for the SC coil set (WI-024).
:>> p_cryo = 0.0 {    // direct cryo-electrical term [MW] -- zeroed; chain derives the slot (WI-024).
:>> vol_cold_cryo = 0.0 {  // ADDITIONAL cold volume [m^3] beyond the winding pack.
:>> f_uplift_cryo = 1.0 {   // unprinted-loads multiplier -- explicit lower bound (WI-024 D6).
:>> f_carnot_cryo = 0.20 {  // fraction-of-Carnot plant efficiency -- THE assumption (WI-024 D4).
:>> precon_fixed_base = 16000000.0 {  // CAS10 fixed adders [$] (WI-025; WI-029 NOAK fix).
:>> installation_frac = 0.14 {  // C220111 fraction of reactor subtotal.
:>> indirect_fraction = 0.20 {  // CAS30 indirect fraction of direct.
:>> om_annual_ref = 54900000.0 {  // CAS70 O&M at 1 GWe, DT [$/yr] (WI-025).
:>> inflation_rate = 0.02 {    // escalation rate g for CAS71/CAS80 levelization.
out attribute gamma : Real = cost_billions * 1.0e9 / bank_energy_joules;
out attribute crf : Real = interest_rate * disc_pow_n / (disc_pow_n - 1.0);
attribute a1 : Real = annual_cost * (1.0 + inflation_rate_in) ** project_time;
out attribute cas70 : Real = cas71 + cas72;
out attribute annual_total : Real = cas71 + cas72 + cas80;
out attribute lcoe : Real = (cas90 + cas70 + cas80) / annual_energy_mwh;
attribute p_cold : Real = (q_nuc * vol_cold * 1.0e-6 + p_fixed) * f_uplift;
attribute total_kAm : Real = G * B * R0 * r_coil / (mu0 * 1000.0);
attribute kAm_wind : Real = n_coils * I_coil * f_set * c_coil / 1000.0;
out attribute m_casing : Real = m_casing_ref * (W_mag / W_mag_ref) ** 0.78;
out attribute B_axis : Real = mu0 * k_link * n_coils * I_coil / (two_pi * R0);
out attribute c_coil : Real = k_coil * R0;
out attribute wall_area : Real = kappa_in * 4.0 * (pi ** 2) * R_in * vacuum_or;
out attribute r_coil_centre : Real = vessel_or + coil_t_in / 2.0;
out attribute beta : Real = 2.0 * mu0 * p_avg_in / (B_in ** 2);
out attribute p_net : Real = (1.0 - rec_frac) * p_et;
